info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law (Professional Law)

description.describe_ch: 開設對象為法律專業組學生。本學期著重於擴大學生國際視野及強化學生專業法學英文能力。學生必須閱讀專業英文法律文獻，並給與充分的練習機會，以進一步提升其聽說讀寫之專業法學英文能力。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed for post-graduate law student. This semester is focus on broaden student’s international perspective and further develop students' professional legal English ability. Students will be required to read legal materials and exploit ample opportunity to practice in order to strengthen students' listening, speaking, reading and writing ability.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生對於國際法律事件的分析及評價能力。
targets.describe_en: Train the analysis and appraisal ability to the international legal events.

targets.describe_ch: 透過課堂的討論及報告，加強學生專業法律英文口語能力。
targets.describe_en: To strengthen students' speaking skills by class discussions and oral presentation.

targets.describe_ch: 透過閱讀文獻與文件寫作，加強學生專業法律英文讀寫能力。
targets.describe_en: To strengthen students' reading and writing abilities through reading and essay writing.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生具備使用外文資料庫(Lexis和Westlaw)查閱英美法相關法令、判決和文獻之能力。
targets.describe_en: Learn to use on-line computer research databases (Lexis and Westlaw) for legislations, case laws, various categories of legal documents and academic papers.
